## Core computation files (all under `.../rest/function/owner/`)

### customerCode — `AssignCustomerCode.java`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignCustomerCode.java`
- `public void service(@Val Owner owner)` (line 18) sets the code as `<REGION>-<HASH8>`:
  - Line 19: `owner.setCustomerCode(Locality.region(owner) + "-" + hash8(blank(owner.getTelephone()) + blank(owner.getLastName())));`
  - `hash8(String)` (lines 22-34): SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes, takes first 4 bytes, formats each `%02X` → 8 upper-case hex chars.
- Note: this is the actual algorithm. It is NOT the `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` described in openapi.yml (stale doc — see below).

### customerCode de-duplication — `DeduplicateCustomerCode.java`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/DeduplicateCustomerCode.java`
- `service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository)` (line 17): on collision with any existing owner's code, appends `-<n>` with smallest `n >= 2` (lines 22-27).

### checkDigit (Luhn) — `CheckDigit.java`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/CheckDigit.java`
- `public static Integer checkDigit(Owner owner)` (line 13). Reads `owner.getCustomerCode()`; returns null if null. Luhn over the digit chars of the customerCode (rightmost doubled, alternating; subtract 9 when >9); returns `(10 - (sum % 10)) % 10` (line 35).

### region — `Locality.java`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Locality.java`
- `CITY_REGION` map (lines 14-15): Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD.
- `locality(Owner)` (line 17): returns the REGION segment (substring before first `-`) of the assigned `customerCode`; falls back to `region(owner)` when no code yet.
- `region(Owner)` (line 28): postcode-range wins (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099 via `byPostcode`, lines 33-42), else `CITY_REGION` lookup, else `"UNKNOWN"`.

### fiscal year — `FiscalYear.java`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/FiscalYear.java`
- FY starts 1 July, named for the calendar year it ends in.
- `endYear(LocalDate)` (line 16): `month >= 7 ? year+1 : year`.
- `label(LocalDate)` (line 21): `String.format("FY%02d", endYear(date) % 100)` → e.g. `FY26`.
- `elapsed(from, to)` (line 26): `endYear(to) - endYear(from)`.

### owner segment — `OwnerSegment.java`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerSegment.java`

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific (MR/MRS/MS/DR). When present it prefixes the salutation.
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. On write, accepted for
            backward-compatibility when the structured addressLine1 is absent. On
            read, the composed normalized address (addressLine1, plus a space and
            addressLine2 when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when present; an owner is valid with either a non-blank
            addressLine1 or the flat address, plus a city.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. When present, drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow this owner even if another owner shares the same lastName and address.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode."
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path for this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by its id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The title and last name ('DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Who'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. Raw 'telephone' stays E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: "Unified member identifier '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region code, the 2-digit fiscal year of the registration date, the first eight upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over telephone + lastName, and a single Luhn check digit over the digits of the preceding segments."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW263F5A1B9C4'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "'FY<YY>' for the fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, named for the calendar year it ends in."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners at the same lastName and address who opted in with sharesHousehold. Absent otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "Derived duplicate key: normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey matches."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: Number of existing owners sharing the same firstName and lastName (case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Membership points: +2 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of three or more, +3 for tenure over 365 days."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "Region derived from city via a fixed table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "Segment as '<TIER>_<AREA>': TIER is 'PREMIUM' at membershipLevel 3 or more else 'STANDARD'; AREA is 'METRO' for a known region (NSW/VIC/QLD) else 'REGIONAL'."
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "IANA timezone derived from the locality/region via a fixed table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent for any other region."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "'EMAIL' when the owner has an email, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "Derived from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when birthDate is omitted."
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created today at the moment this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already held 40-49 owners (approaching the hard limit of 50) at the moment this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:

              minimum: 0

            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: True when the owner has been soft-deleted (the record is retained but excluded from duplicate/identity checks), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
